startup_path_policy: Compact re-entry path only; carry IDs, counts, and the current execution cards plus the field-handoff bundle, next-action, owner-review, and result-recorder utilities here, then use reentry-navigation-map.md, BRANCH_FAMILY_INDEX.json, SURFACES.json, CUBE_SCHEMA_REGISTRY.json, CUBE_SURFACE_CONTRACTS.json, FOLLOWTHROUGH_QUEUE.json, and ARCHIVE_INDEX.md for expansion rather than embedding branch-history tails, full ledgers, or done followthrough records.
current_summary: rev0336 makes post-result repeat/continue executable through a source-result hash-linked fresh-packet path: the packet generator validates a prior local non-evidence result, writes FOLLOWTHROUGH-SOURCE-RESULT links, readiness checks source drift, and the router emits make micro-pilot-followthrough-pack instead of a generic repeat command.

live_followthrough.objective: Import real pilot records when available and compare them against the realistic schema examples, trimming fields that do not change decisions and adding only fields that prevent overclaiming, protected-route leakage, hidden authority, or learner harm.
live_followthrough.current_blocker: rev0336 still has no real educator conversation, owner-completed plan, local cycle, owner review, SRC2+ packet, route block, legitimate result, source-linked follow-through from a real result, or FT-0181 closure.
live_followthrough.current_action: Run field-handoff-bundle, open the rev0336 discovery card/owner plan/run sheet, secure one teacher/tutor conversation, complete the local plan, preserve generated run-definition hashes and valid session chronology, run one approved feasibility cycle only if entry-ready, then record aggregates with small-cell and final-readout redaction. If a non-retire local result is recorded, use make micro-pilot-followthrough-pack with SOURCE_RESULT and the confirmation token to create exactly one source-linked fresh packet from local owner choices; never treat the result as evidence. Use the owner rail only for a real send, route block, or returned packet.
